name: Skarn Isle
description: A black island in the sea south-east of Telgard, bare of anything but Maldrath's fortress.

landing.name: The Bridge of Light
landing.description: The end of the rainbow bridge on the island side. The light dims behind you, and the island is a place of black shale and dead trees.

fields.name: The Blasted Shore
fields.description: Fused black rock and ash, and a single path winding up toward the fortress.

approach.name: The Approach
approach.description: A broad, scarred road up to a pair of iron gates with the keep's towers behind them.

gate.name: The Iron Gate
gate.description: The gates of Skarnhold stand open, as if the owner did not expect to need them closed. A great dark hall waits beyond.
